evaluation_datasets_scope_ck.name: evaluation_datasets_scope_ck
evaluation_datasets_scope_ck.value: ("evaluation_datasets"."scope" = 'global' and "evaluation_datasets"."organization_id" is null and "evaluation_datasets"."repository_path" is not null and "evaluation_datasets"."stored_object_id" is null) or ("evaluation_datasets"."scope" = 'organization' and "evaluation_datasets"."organization_id" is not null and "evaluation_datasets"."repository_path" is null and "evaluation_datasets"."stored_object_id" is not null)

evaluation_metrics_all_dimensions_uq.name: evaluation_metrics_all_dimensions_uq

evaluation_metrics_behavior_dimension_uq.name: evaluation_metrics_behavior_dimension_uq
evaluation_metrics_behavior_dimension_uq.where: "evaluation_metrics"."behavior_kind" is not null and "evaluation_metrics"."evidence_tier" is null

evaluation_metrics_tier_dimension_uq.name: evaluation_metrics_tier_dimension_uq
evaluation_metrics_tier_dimension_uq.where: "evaluation_metrics"."behavior_kind" is null and "evaluation_metrics"."evidence_tier" is not null

evaluation_metrics_scope_ck.name: evaluation_metrics_scope_ck

evaluation_runs_scope_ck.name: evaluation_runs_scope_ck
evaluation_runs_scope_ck.value: ("evaluation_runs"."scope" = 'global' and "evaluation_runs"."organization_id" is null and "evaluation_runs"."api_service_id" is null) or ("evaluation_runs"."scope" = 'organization' and "evaluation_runs"."organization_id" is not null)

usage_rollups_nonnegative_ck.name: usage_rollups_nonnegative_ck
usage_rollups_nonnegative_ck.value: "usage_rollups"."ingested_sessions" >= 0 and "usage_rollups"."observed_requests_estimate" >= 0 and "usage_rollups"."stored_bytes" >= 0 and "usage_rollups"."replay_requests" >= 0 and "usage_rollups"."llm_input_tokens" >= 0 and "usage_rollups"."llm_output_tokens" >= 0 and "usage_rollups"."llm_cost_microunits" >= 0 and "usage_rollups"."job_failures" >= 0

claim_evidence_sequence_ck.name: claim_evidence_sequence_ck
claim_evidence_sequence_ck.value: "claim_evidence"."request_sequence_no" is null or "claim_evidence"."response_sequence_no" is null or "claim_evidence"."request_sequence_no" > "claim_evidence"."response_sequence_no"

gate_impacts_tier_target_ck.name: gate_impacts_tier_target_ck
gate_impacts_tier_target_ck.value: ("gate_impacts"."assertion_id" is not null and "gate_impacts"."effective_tier" is null) or ("gate_impacts"."dependency_claim_id" is not null and "gate_impacts"."effective_tier" is not null)

notification_routes_channel_ck.name: notification_routes_channel_ck
notification_routes_channel_ck.value: ("notification_routes"."channel" = 'in_app' and "notification_routes"."slack_installation_id" is null and "notification_routes"."destination_id" is null) or ("notification_routes"."channel" = 'slack' and "notification_routes"."slack_installation_id" is not null and length(trim("notification_routes"."destination_id")) > 0)

jobs_payload_object_tenant_ck.name: jobs_payload_object_tenant_ck
jobs_payload_object_tenant_ck.value: "jobs"."payload_object_id" is null or "jobs"."organization_id" is not null

scheduled_tasks_service_tenant_ck.name: scheduled_tasks_service_tenant_ck
scheduled_tasks_service_tenant_ck.value: "scheduled_tasks"."api_service_id" is null or "scheduled_tasks"."organization_id" is not null
